## pi-web-ui 0.6.4

This release brings the Web, npm and Desktop distributions back to the same version.

- The composer shows provider-reported context usage and cache read/write counts. The four context categories are clearly labeled local estimates.
- Pasted terminal tables stay inside the user bubble as fixed-width, horizontally scrollable blocks. Long user messages fold after eight lines, and workspace paths such as `docs/file.md:23` open the file at that line.
- Empty streaming thinking and text blocks no longer create a gap above “Analyzing request…”. The waiting label sits directly below the model heading, and adjacent messages have tighter spacing.
- Message navigation, bash output previews and the file panel have cleaner layouts and clearer controls.

The npm package is `@youweichen/pi-web-ui@0.6.4`. Desktop installers are built for macOS, Windows and Linux. They are unsigned; macOS may require right-click → Open, and Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher prompt.
